name: short halves initial check
description: How do two 2.0- or 2.5-minute halves change actual full-match tries, points and contacts versus current two 7-minute halves, on the unchanged 100m field? This is the duration-only control before any field-length or defensive-retreat change. The harness normalises count columns to 14 minutes; multiply those means/SEs by result.minutes/14 to recover actual match totals.
